title: Memory Leak
description: The world remembers every death you've ever had. The longer you play, the faster reality rots, distorts, and goes mad — ghosts of the past come to watch you, blocks whisper.

--- ## 📖 What is this? **Memory Leak** is a psychological horror mod. No jump scares. No bosses. No new weapons. It doesn't scream in your face — it *convinces* you that something is wrong with your world. Slowly. Quietly. Irreversibly. > *Your world is not a world. It's a file that was never closed.* --- ## 👁️ What will happen? At first — small things. A strange sound behind you. A block that wasn't quite what it seemed, just for a second. Then — worse. The world around you starts to *change*. Things appear that shouldn't be here. Sometimes the game itself feels like it's standing on the edge of something. The longer you stay, the thinner the border becomes between your world and whatever lies next to it.
> *You are probably not the first one here.*
*And almost certainly not the last.*

Pick your level of comfort in the in-game config. There is no "safe" one.
--- ## 📦 Requirements & Installation
📋 Requirements
- **Minecraft** `26.1.x` - **Fabric Loader** - **Fabric API** - **Java 25+**
💾 How to install
1. Install the **Fabric Loader** for Minecraft `26.1.x`. 2. Download the latest **Fabric API**. 3. Drop both **Fabric API** and **Memory Leak** into your `mods/` folder. 4. Launch the game with **Java 25+**. > For the full experience on servers, install the mod on **both** the server and every client.
❓ FAQ
**Is Fabric API required?** Yes. The mod won't load without it. **Does it work in multiplayer?** Yes — it runs on client *and* server. Install it on both sides. **Can I add it to an existing world?** You can, but it's best to start fresh and let things unfold from the beginning. **Is there a resource pack?** Not yet. Stay tuned. **Something broke / I found a bug.** Report it on [GitHub Issues](https://github.com/kasperoid31/unmemorable-team/issues) or in our [Discord](https://discord.gg/wtGCQfjhB2).
--- ## 🎧 Advice
**Play with headphones. At night. Alone.** *It's not a bug. It's a leak.*
